comment: Builds the dual-use shared/*.ts sources to committed CommonJS+global shared/*.js (npm run build:shared), emitting each .js next to its .ts. Separate from the client tsconfig because these need Node's `module` global and emit, where the client config is DOM-only + noEmit. The .js outputs are committed so a plain `node server.js` deploy needs no build step; check:shared-fresh guards them against drift. noImplicitAny is off here: the large flow-action-registry/game-data definition arrays and room-effect callbacks aren't worth per-param typing; strictNullChecks and the rest of strict stay on, and the contract files (color/config/schema/constants) carry explicit types.
